payload.claim: The spec's own Notes for the agent state that the measured estimated_lines: 362 "prices past 80%" of the feature type's size ceiling (3000 tokens) once multiplied by the measured-overrun ratio, and that "the operator accepts it." Because risk: elevated is declared, the size gate's plan-time blocker is live at this tier (size_blocks returns true exactly at elevated), so absent an accepted override this would otherwise stop the cell before it starts. The spec records that the overrun was accepted, but nothing in the spec file itself pins down when or against what ratio that acceptance was made -- the ratio driver.py check computes is a rolling median over landed measured specs (186 such specs already exist in done/), so the 80%+ figure is not fixed and could have moved since whoever wrote that note last ran check. A person should confirm, by re-running driver.py check SA-0429 against the current ledger, that this size-ceiling exception still holds before a cell is allowed to spend against this spec.
